Sunburst plot of indicator outcomes for one category, bay segment, and year

Source: R/plot_category.R
plot_category.Rd

Sunburst plot of indicator outcomes for one category, bay segment, and year

Usage

plot_category(
  ...,
  bay_segment,
  yr,
  bay_segments = c("OTB", "HB", "MTB", "LTB"),
  yr_min = 2000,
  wt = NULL
)

Arguments

...

named data.frames, passed to anlz_category. See its documentation (and anlz_indicators) for the expected shape

bay_segment

chr string, single bay segment to plot, must be one of bay_segments

yr

integer, single year to plot

bay_segments

chr vector of bay segments to include, passed to anlz_category, defaults to c('OTB', 'HB', 'MTB', 'LTB')

yr_min

integer, minimum year to include, passed to anlz_category, defaults to 2000

wt

named numeric vector of indicator weights, passed to anlz_category

Value

A plotly htmlwidget

Details

Calls anlz_category on ... to get both the per-indicator outcomes (one wide column per indicator) and the overall category score for bay_segment/yr, then plots a two-ring sunburst using a colored center for the category's overall outcome and an outer ring with one equal-size wedge per indicator colored by that indicator's own outcome. Both rings use the same continuous red/yellow/green outcome scale, and an indicator missing for bay_segment/yr still gets an equal-size wedge, rendered gray rather than dropped. Thematically identical to plot_score, which extends this same two-ring layout with a third ring combining several categories.

Examples

plot_category(
  wq_attain = data.frame(bay_segment = 'OTB', yr = 2020, outcome = 0.8),
  fib = data.frame(bay_segment = 'OTB', yr = 2020, outcome = 0.4),
  bay_segment = 'OTB', yr = 2020
)
